html: † III. [אַמָּה] n.f. (etym. & meaning dub.; Thes foundation (cf. Talm. AW), from אֵם in metaph. sense, cf. MV; De on Is 6:4 der. similarly, but makes support of superliminaria (cf. 𝔊 𝔖 𝔙); Ew Di from √ ii. אמם = أَمَّ precede, whence إِمَامٌ front; DlPr 110 tr. holder from √ אמם be wide, hence contain, hold) only אַמּוֹת הַסִּפִּים Is 6:4.
